title: symphyotrichum ciliatum
intro: Symphyotrichum ciliatum, commonly known as Frostweed or White Panicle Aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant has been utilized in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, wounds, and inflammation due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. Symphyotrichum ciliatum's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antimicrobial and antioxidant agent, which helps to protect against oxidative stress and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
